decisions.reason: The illustrated series is a multi-model line built on the label's core reissue competence, so its option value is still unfolding while catalog upkeep costs little, which justifies keeping it open even though it has not been observed recently.
A reissued jazz LP sits in a durable collector niche, and as a catalog item it costs little to keep listed while vinyl demand stays strong, so there is no evidence yet that justifies abandoning it.

Multi-disc box sets are usually limited editions that sell out and quietly leave the shop, so withdrawal is fairly likely, but keeping remaining stock listed is cheap, so the option stays open for now.

The compilation CD had only a minor web presence, which resembles the already dropped Product A and makes the evidence weak, but carrying it in a warehouse-backed catalog costs little, so it is kept while results remain unclear.
